text: 据新华社，2026年9月23日至25日，国家主席习近平对美国进行国事访问。行程结束之际，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅向随行记者介绍此访情况。
text_en: According to Xinhua News Agency, from September 23 to 25, 2026, President Xi Jinping paid a state visit to the United States. At the conclusion of the visit, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister, briefed accompanying journalists on the visit.
